meaning.en: A geologist whose speciality is geomorphology.
meaning.vi: Một nhà địa chất có chuyên môn là địa mạo.

sentences.en: This is more widely known to geomorphologists by its Germanic corruption, Karst.

sentences.en: Marie, a young French geomorphologist who had been the joker of our team in the daytime, was convinced we were all doomed.
sentences.vi: Marie, một nhà địa mạo học trẻ tuổi người Pháp, người đã từng là trò đùa của nhóm chúng tôi vào ban ngày, tin rằng tất cả chúng tôi đều phải chết.

sentences.en: Stephan Harrison is a geomorphologist, specialising in landscape responses to climate change, at Exeter University and Oxford University.

sentences.en: The formulation of classifications provides, if nothing else, mental exercise for geomorphologists.

sentences.en: The river basin is a well-defined spatial unit that is of great interest to hydrologists, geomorphologists and geographers.
